description: Natural-language full-text search over the entire veteran-resource corpus (name, services, notes, city). Use when the user types a free-form query like "PTSD counseling houston" or "VA hospital san diego" instead of a bare ZIP. Returns top results ranked by BM25 relevance. Crisis keywords route to the Veterans Crisis Line automatically.

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP to bias results within 50 miles

name: search_veteran_resources_by_text
title: Search veteran resources by keyword
